correctness.rationale: The eight-state CTMC decomposes into independent cycle and gate eigenfunctions; centered covariance is (1/2)e^{-a|t|}cos(bt)+(1/4)e^{-2r|t|}, giving exact bilateral PSD. With s=(b/a)²,u=r/a,c=1+s,d=3s−1,z=(ω/a)², exact common-denominator subtraction has sign zH(z), H=C+Bz−Az², with strictly positive denominator and A=c+4u>0. For s≤1/3 no z>0 can make H positive. For s>1/3 any witness 0<z<d satisfies ∂_uH=4(d−z)(12u²+z)>0, guaranteeing a unique rate onset. At u0=(c³/(16d))^{1/3}, C=0 and B=cF(s), F′>0 with a unique zero s*. For s≤s* threshold u0 is continuous; for s>s*, strict concavity enforces a unique positive interior tangency B²+4AC=0 at u_c<u0. Local expansion of spectral excess near threshold gives square root in ω below s*, quartic degeneration and quarter root exactly s*, and finite jump for s>s*. Endpoint s=1 discriminant factors by 2u⁴−2u³+3u²−1. Independent exact symbolic rational identity and factorization plus 15 continuous-peak parameter checks corroborate, not prove all real parameters.
